scope: Direct per-fingerprint nonpersonal numeric execution review for every currently tracked client-facing database role (authenticated/authenticator/anon/service_role), including full per-item identity/field/counter signature and assessment. No statement texts or member/Auth records.
provider_query: SELECT r.rolname AS role,s.queryid::text AS queryid,s.calls,round(s.total_exec_time::numeric,3)::text AS total_ms,round(s.mean_exec_time::numeric,3)::text AS mean_ms,round(s.max_exec_time::numeric,3)::text AS max_ms,s.rows,s.shared_blks_read AS shared_read,s.shared_blks_hit AS shared_hit,s.temp_blks_written AS temp_write,s.wal_bytes::text AS wal_bytes,md5(concat_ws('|',r.rolname,s.queryid::text,s.calls::text,round(s.total_exec_time::numeric,3)::text,round(s.mean_exec_time::numeric,3)::text,round(s.max_exec_time::numeric,3)::text,s.rows::text,s.shared_blks_read::text,s.shared_blks_hit::text,s.temp_blks_written::text,s.wal_bytes::text)) AS snapshot_md5 FROM extensions.pg_stat_statements s JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid=s.userid WHERE s.dbid=(SELECT oid FROM pg_database WHERE datname=current_database()) AND r.rolname IN ('authenticated','authenticator','anon','service_role') ORDER BY r.rolname,s.queryid
cautions: Cumulative counters since independent pg_stat_statements reset; cannot infer recent p95, current response time, or causal user impact
Planner/cache warmup and background PostgREST gateway queries are not necessarily application defects
Mean >100ms from 4 and 94 cumulative calls is observation, not evidence of a regression
SQL query text deliberately withheld to avoid leaking literal values; this is numeric performance review only
unverified: actual signed-in client latency and request-to-query attribution
next_cursor: Stored Supabase migration #60 if introduced; otherwise first genuinely new/changed/unreviewed provider definition or newly accessible hosted Auth/API security control with #96. Do not re-credit already reviewed SQL source.
